label: New filing: the documents each kind of return needs - what each is, and where to get it
aliases: new filing: the documents each kind of return needs - what each is, and where to get it

default.label: AIS - Annual Information Statement
default.what: Everything reported on the PAN: salary, interest, dividends, sales of shares, funds and property, tax paid.
default.where: incometax.gov.in > Services > Annual Information Statement (AIS) > download the PDF. Its password: the PAN in small letters and the date of birth (DDMMYYYY).

default.label: AIS of the business (CSV)
default.what: Receipts, interest and TDS reported on the business's PAN - set beside the books in Reconcile.
default.where: incometax.gov.in (signed in as the business) > Services > Annual Information Statement (AIS) > download as CSV.

default.label: Form 26AS
default.what: Every TDS and TCS credited to the PAN, and the tax paid - as the department holds it.
default.where: incometax.gov.in > e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Form 26AS > TRACES > Export as text (or PDF).

default.label: Pre-filled JSON
default.what: Who you are, salary, TDS, taxes paid and bank accounts in one file - the quickest start.
default.where: incometax.gov.in > e-File > Income Tax Returns > Download Pre-Filled Data > AY {ay}.

default.label: Form 16 from each employer
default.what: Part A: TDS by quarter (from TRACES). Part B: salary, exempt allowances and deductions.
default.where: Your employer's HR or payroll portal - due by 15 June.

default.label: Capital-gains statement
default.what: Each sale: units, dates, cost, sale value and the 31 January 2018 value.
default.where: CAMS (camsonline.com) or KFintech (kfintech.com) > Capital gains statement for FY {fy}; your broker's back office > Tax P&L.

default.label: Sale deed and purchase papers
default.what: Sale price, stamp-duty value, the buyer's PAN and TDS, what the property cost, a new house or bonds bought.
default.where: The registered deed from the sub-registrar; the buyer's Form 16B for the TDS. Entered on Review.

default.label: Home-loan interest certificate; rent received
default.what: Interest paid (s.24(b)), principal (80C), and for a house let out the rent and municipal tax.
default.where: Your lender's portal or branch; the rent agreement. Entered on Review.

default.label: Bank statement
default.what: Receipts with no TDS, cash deposits, interest the AIS may not show.
default.where: Net banking > Statements > the financial year, as Excel, CSV or PDF.

default.label: GSTR-3B summary
default.what: The GST turnover per GSTIN - set beside the receipts.
default.where: gst.gov.in > Services > Returns > View filed returns > GSTR-3B for each month (or the year's summary).

default.label: Your exchange's tax report
default.what: Each crypto transfer: what it cost, what it sold for, the dates.
default.where: The exchange's tax or P&L report. Entered on Review.

default.label: Foreign account and holding statements
default.what: Peak and closing balance, income and tax paid abroad - for the calendar year {cy}.
default.where: The foreign bank, broker or employer's stock plan. Entered on Review (Schedule FA); Form 67 for the credit.

default.label: Days in India
default.what: Days in India this year and the years before decide residence.
default.where: Passport stamps or the immigration record. Entered on Review.

default.label: Arrears by year (Form 10E)
default.what: Which years the arrears belong to, and each year's income.
default.where: Your employer; Form 10E is filed on incometax.gov.in before the return.

default.label: Last year's return (JSON)
default.what: Its Schedule CFL - the losses still to carry forward.
default.where: incometax.gov.in > e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns > the year before > Download JSON.

default.label: The return being revised (JSON)
default.what: Compared figure by figure with the one you are making now.
default.where: incometax.gov.in > e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns > AY {ay} > Download JSON.

default.label: Deduction proofs
default.what: 80C (PPF, ELSS, LIC, tuition), 80D health cover, NPS, donations - old regime only, except the employer's NPS.
default.where: Each provider's statement. Entered on Review.

default.label: GST registration certificate (REG-06)
default.what: The GSTIN, the legal name and the constitution - the client is made from it.
default.where: gst.gov.in > Services > User Services > View / Download Certificates.

default.label: Partnership deed, LLP agreement or trust deed
default.what: Who the partners (or members) are, their shares, and the salary and interest the deed allows (s.40(b)).
default.where: The firm's own signed copy; for an LLP the agreement filed with the MCA (Form 3).

default.label: Financial statements or trial balance (Excel)
default.what: Trading or manufacturing account, profit and loss, balance sheet - each row tagged in Intake & map.
default.where: Tally > Display > Statements of accounts > export to Excel; or the accountant's final accounts.

default.label: GSTR-3B and GSTR-1 (JSON)
default.what: Each month's returns from the GST portal - the tax audit sets them against the books.
default.where: gst.gov.in > Returns > View e-filed returns > Download JSON for each month (or the zip of them).

default.label: Closing stock list and valuation
default.what: Quantity and value of raw material, work in progress and finished goods on 31 March.
default.where: The stock register; tagged with the books in Intake & map.

default.label: Fixed-asset register
default.what: Each block's opening value, additions (with dates), sales and depreciation.
default.where: A sheet in the books' Excel - tagged in Intake & map (Form 3CD clause 18).

default.label: Last year's return (ITR-5 JSON)
default.what: Last year's figures and losses - brought in on Import old returns.
default.where: incometax.gov.in (signed in as the business) > e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns > Download JSON.

default.label: Certificate of incorporation
default.what: The CIN, the date of incorporation and the directors - the company is made from it.
default.where: MCA21 > View company master data / public documents; the company's own copy.

default.label: Computation of income (Excel)
default.what: The CA's computation - with the Form 29B book-profit rows for MAT.
default.where: The tax working for the year, exported to Excel - tagged in Intake & map.

default.label: Fixed-asset schedule (Excel)
default.what: Each block's opening value, additions (the 180-day split), sales and depreciation.
default.where: The depreciation schedule as per the Income-tax Rules - tagged in Intake & map.

description_nl: 2026-10-11: the checklist of 'Documents you'll need': each document's reader kind (blank = typed on Review), the picks it is needed or good to have for ('any' = every return), what it is and where to get it ({ay} {fy} {cy} filled from the year). 2026-10-11: the checklist of 'Documents you'll need': each document's reader kind (blank = typed later), the flows it belongs to (My return, the firm flow), the picks and who it is needed or good to have for ('any' = every return), what it is and where to get it ({ay} {fy} {cy} filled from the year).
